baseline.note: File chooser automation stalled before handing off the File. Only the application-reported importTime is used; wall-clock automation duration is excluded.

notes: One sequential pair on the same fresh origin, same input File and hardware. Not randomized or a stable upper bound; disk caches and background load can affect either run.
Application-reported importTime excludes file chooser automation delay. Another candidate import on origin port 4318 took 46.17 s.
No total browser/Worker peak RAM measurement.
